div.head: Hn 28.6
div.ab: Et licet infinita delinquencium multitudo modum miseracionis incommodet, uno uerbo concludimur: Quod tibi non uis fieri, alii ne feceris.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 562 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page); Liebermann’s footnote p has ‘Iro’ for ‘Ivo’; transcribed as printed

note.seg: Alexander Severus dici iubebat: ‘Quod tibi fieri non uis, alteri ne feceris’; Ael. Lamprid. 51; nur im Sinne gleich Matth. 7, 12; in der Vulgata steht wörtlich am nächsten Tob. 4, 16: Quod ab alio oderis fieri tibi, vide ne tu aliquando alteri facias. Vielleicht las Verf. einige Zeilen weiter hinter den eben benutzten Canones: quod vultis vobis non fieri, alteri non faciatis; Iro Pan. IV 112 aus Ps.-Isidor, ed. Hinschius 243

Alexander Severus dici iubebat: ‘Quod tibi fieri non uis, alteri ne feceris’; Ael. Lamprid. 51; the same only in sense as Matth. 7, 12; in the Vulgate the closest verbally is Tob. 4, 16: Quod ab alio oderis fieri tibi, vide ne tu aliquando alteri facias. Perhaps the author read, a few lines further on after the canons just used: quod vultis vobis non fieri, alteri non faciatis; Iro Pan. IV 112 from Ps.-Isidore, ed. Hinschius 243
